Phiṭsūtra
gr. on the accents of nominal an. pronominal stems etc. in four pādas containing 87 sūtras. ascribed to Śantanu (but Śāntanavācārya in mss.); a post-Pāṇinian text. See Y. Mimamsak, Sam3skṛta Vyākaraṇ Śāstra kā Itihās II. p.. 273-83 an. George Cardona, Pāṇini A Survey of Research p.. 174-77.
For a brief note on the chronological order of the Phiṭsūtras, the Uṇādisūtras an. the Aṣṭādhyāyī, see K. V. Abhayankar, J. of Ori. Inst., M. S. Uni. Baroda XIX. p.. 331 ff.
